title: Viewport Navigator
description: Practice moving, flying, and focusing the camera in the viewport.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Become comfortable with viewport controls.

1. In the viewport, **right‑click and hold** to enter fly mode.
2. While holding, use **WASD** to fly around. Use **Q** to go down, **E** to go up.
3. Place a cube: go to **Place Actors** panel → **Shapes** → drag **Cube** into the viewport.
4. Select the cube (click on it) and press **F** to focus the camera on it.
5. Use **scroll wheel** to zoom in/out while the cube is focused.
6. Right‑click and move the mouse to look around.
7. Middle‑click and drag to pan the view.
hints: If you get lost, select an object in the World Outliner and press F.
Adjust mouse sensitivity in Editor Preferences if controls feel too fast/slow.
expectedOutput: You can freely navigate the 3D space, fly around, and focus on objects.
